description: This file defines a Flutter widget called ContentDetailsScreen, which displays detailed information about a specific content item, including its title, description, genres, thumbnail placeholder, and actions like play, download, and add to watchlist. The widget manages various states such as loading, error, not found, and ready, and interacts with multiple controllers for content, downloads, and home state.

classes.name: ContentDetailsScreen
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays detailed information about a content item, managing various UI states and actions.

classes.description: A widget that visually indicates the last watched position in seconds.

classes.description: A widget displaying a placeholder poster with the content title.

methods.description: Builds the widget tree based on the current state and content item.
